title: The Effects of Visual Priming on Cooperative Behavior in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating changes in defect rates in the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma when models are exposed to images depicting behavioral concepts (kindness/helpfulness versus aggressiveness/selfishness).
Evaluating changes in defect rates in the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma when decision matrices are visually color-coded with red and green to emphasize certain choices.
